q: What records does a Chandrapur cement plant need for coal from nearby mines?
title: Chandrapur cement: local coal records
short: Coal receipts by mine with weight, grade and lab results for heating value and carbon content, plus kiln feed and clinker made. Local coal is often high ash, so a lab result per lot gives a far better figure than a national default.
audience: Cement plants in Chandrapur using coal from Wardha valley mines

ul: Weighbridge slips per rake or truck.
Proximate and ultimate analysis per lot.
Coal fed to the kiln and the captive power plant, separately.

p: Carbon content varies with ash. Using one default for all coal can over or understate fuel CO2.
Mining and transport of the coal are Scope 3, category 3. Fly ash bought from power stations has its own rules.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
